definitions.explanation: A formal or semi-formal statement expressing willingness to do something, making a request, or putting forward a proposal. Derived from the verb 申し出る (to offer, to propose). Used in business and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れた→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧。
⟦ボランティア→ボランティア：04834_borantia⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦{寄|よ}せられた→寄せる：02329_yoseru⟧。
examples.english: Numerous offers to volunteer were received.

examples.japanese: ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申|もう}し{出|で}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧とも{一|いっ}か{月|げつ}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please inform your supervisor of your resignation request at least one month in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal noun derived from the verb {申|もう}し{出|で}る. Used to refer to offers, proposals, and requests in business, administrative, and official settings.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {申|もう}し{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (receive an offer)
- {申|もう}し{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{入|い}れる→受け入れる：05755_ukeireru⟧ (accept an offer)
- {申|もう}し{出|で}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ (decline an offer)
- ⟦{退職|たいしょく}→退職：04559_taishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{申|もう}し{出|で} (resignation request)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{提案|ていあん}→提案：03536_teian⟧: proposal, suggestion (more about ideas or plans)
- ⟦{申請|しんせい}→申請：04207_shinsei⟧: application, formal request (more bureaucratic, involves paperwork)
- ⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧: application, entry (specifically for registering or signing up for something)
